title: Simply for PET Test 5 - Part 2 (Multiple Choice)
instruction: Bạn sẽ nghe 6 đoạn hội thoại ngắn. Với mỗi câu, chọn đáp án đúng A, B hoặc C.

questions.prompt: What does the girl say about it?

options.B: It's worth becoming a full member.
options.C: Members pay extra for some classes.

questions.prompt: How does the boy feel about it?

options.A: He finds it difficult to decide what to buy.

questions.script: Generally I've been happy with what I've bought, so it works for me. Stress-free shopping.

questions.prompt: What does the girl say about herself and her cousin?

options.B: They enjoyed most of their time together.

questions.script: We had different ideas about how to spend our days.

questions.prompt: The girl tells the boy to
questions.script: I'd check it first. ... but it still has some spelling and grammatical mistakes.

questions.prompt: What does the boy think about it?
questions.script: It makes me laugh which is what I need at the end of the day.

questions.prompt: How do the girl's parents feel?

options.A: negative towards her new maths teacher
options.C: surprised by her progress in maths

questions.script: I'm doing better at maths thanks to him. My parents are amazed as they had given up with my maths! They feel grateful to him.
